limitations.note: The patch clocked the rotation register but left `data` combinational, so it reflects the newly rotated state instead of capturing the pre-rotation bit on each rising edge.
The patch made the sequence state reload only on a rising clock edge, losing the immediate reset reload that the original code had and the correct implementation preserves.

The test started checking the pattern immediately after reset release, before the first rising edge, so it accepted the patch’s one-cycle-early output phase and never checked a reset pulse that ended before a rising edge.
